title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, stored mainspring reserve, energy-gated runtime, and an event-resolved Swiss lever escapement that now releases the wheel train beat by beat.
